regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow leadership: AI Compute & Optics leads with very low breadth (0.176) and a close challenger in Industrial Metals (margin 0.195). The absolute-trend gate historically did not cut drawdowns here (mean-reverting tape), making trend discipline experimental. Given the desk's poor directional accuracy (33%) and modest hit rate (43%), all leans carry low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch for a potential leadership handoff to Industrial Metals: if Industrial Metals' score closes the gap and overtakes AI Compute & Optics (margin currently 0.195) while maintaining durability above 0.7 and breadth above 0.6, it would confirm a broad rotation signal.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals exhibits the strongest structural health among top ranks: high durability (0.82), near-universal breadth (0.846), and a confirmed trend tag. The theme is not crowded, and the narrow breadth of the AI leader raises the odds of rotation toward the healthier trend. The lean is a relative preference, not a return forecast, justified by the absolute-trend eligibility and strong coherence.
theses.dissent: Cyclical metal demand can reverse sharply on a China economic slowdown or global risk-off, and the trend gate has historically failed to mitigate drawdowns in this market, making the discipline unreliable.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS underperforms the CSI 300 by more than 5% between 2026-08-06 and 2026-09-03 (20 trading days).

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute retains the top momentum rank and trend tag with no crowding, but breadth is alarmingly low (0.176), signaling a fragile, concentration-driven rally. The theme merits an overweight only if the trend persists on a short leash; the durability bar (0.53) is moderate. The call is conditional on the narrow base not cracking.
theses.dissent: Extremely low breadth (0.176) indicates that the theme is driven by a tiny handful of stocks; any reversal in those names could erase the trend, and the lack of broad participation undermines durability.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS closes below its 20-day simple moving average and remains below it for three consecutive sessions within the next 15 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
